intro: New-episode alerts arrive at the hour you picked, in your own time.

groups.title: Fixes
items: New-episode alerts go out at the hour you chose, read in your own time zone rather than the server's.
Each signed-in device has its own clearly named sign-out, so it is obvious which one you are ending.

intro: Your own corner of a shared Frog: your account, your devices, and a profile when you want one.

groups.title: Highlights
items: **Your account.** Change your password, see every device you are signed in on and sign out of any of them, switch account from the menu at the top right, or delete your account.
**Profiles.** Turn on your profile to let others on your Frog see what you are watching, your favourites and your totals. It is off until you turn it on, and nobody outside your Frog can see it.
**Who is here.** Administration lists every account. Change a role, switch an account off, and see the space Frog uses and when it was last backed up.

groups.title: Improvements
items: The top bar keeps search and your account in reach on every screen size.

groups.title: Fixes
items: Invitation links open the page for joining, and Administration is in the menu for owners and administrators.

intro: Frog holds more than one person now, and everybody's library is their own.

groups.title: Highlights
items: **An account each.** Your library, ratings, episodes, diary, notes, favourites, shelves, settings and notifications belong to you. Nobody else on the same Frog can see them or change them.
**Invitations.** There is no sign-up page. An administrator makes a link that works once and stops working after that; whoever opens it picks a name and a password.
**Administration.** One page for making invitations, seeing which are still open, which were used and by whom, and withdrawing any nobody took.

groups.title: Improvements
items: About credits the people who make Frog.

groups.title: Fixes
items: About shows the name of the release you are running.

intro: Your year in numbers, shelves of your own, and a nudge when a new episode is out.

groups.title: Highlights
items: **Your stats, in full.** Time watched, streaks, genres, decades, how you rate, and the actors, directors and studios you watch most, for all time or for any year.
**Year in review.** A card of your year in film and TV, ready to share from your phone or save as an image.

**New-episode alerts.** Turn on notifications in Settings and Frog tells you when a show you follow has a new episode out. Mute any show with the bell on its page. Needs Frog opened over HTTPS, such as through Tailscale Serve.
**Shelves.** Hand-pick titles into shelves and drag them into your own order, or make a smart shelf that fills itself, such as shows in progress rated 8 or more.
**Because you watched.** Home suggests titles like the ones you rated highest, leaving out anything already in your library.

**Import from AniList and MyAnimeList.** Enter an AniList username or choose a MyAnimeList export. Each season on your list lands on the right season on TMDB, parts and long-running seasons included, with the episodes you have seen already ticked. Anything Frog is unsure of asks you first.
**When did you watch this?** Marking a season or a whole show asks: today, on release, on a date you pick, or you don't know. Undated episodes count towards your progress and stay out of the diary.
**A tidier diary.** A day of one show is one entry, such as "S04E08–E16 · 9 episodes", that opens to show each episode. Change the date of any entry.
**Two-factor sign-in.** Turn it on in Settings → Security, scan the code with any authenticator app, and keep ten recovery codes for a lost phone.
**Choose your tabs.** On phones, pick four tabs and find the rest under More. Reorder or hide pages in Settings → Navigation.

groups.title: Improvements
items: Import and export live in Settings → Your data, in the Library menu and on an empty library.
Each status has its own colour, everywhere it appears.
The calendar shows what is on inside each day, with a legend, and the chosen day opens beside the month.
Home's hero reads clearly on light themes and says Start watching for a show you have not begun.
Data saver loads smaller images.
Calendar and Diary can be your start page.
Mark a whole show watched from its page.
Sign-in remembers this device unless you untick Keep me signed in.
Add any title to a shelf from its page.
A film you mark as watched appears in your diary and stats.
Stats and Shelves open offline, like the rest of the app.

groups.title: Fixes
items: Frog opens and works offline once installed, signed in.
The command palette's search field sits on one line.
Season headers fit on narrow phones.
Every dropdown uses Frog's own menu.
With nothing in progress, Home's hero shows your newest addition as Recently added.

intro: Import your library from elsewhere, plan the week ahead, and read back everything you have watched.

groups.title: Highlights
items: **Import from Letterboxd, Trakt, IMDb, TV Time and Frog backups.** A guided importer reads the export, finds each title on TMDB and shows you the matches before anything is written. Anything uncertain is flagged so you can choose the right one, and you decide whether the file or your library wins.
**Export your library** as a full JSON backup or a CSV, from the Import page or the command palette.
**Calendar.** A month view and an agenda of every episode and release you follow, with the days you have already watched marked off.
**Diary.** Everything you have watched, newest first, grouped by month, with rewatches and episode ratings in line.
**About page** with version, credits and licences.

groups.title: Improvements
items: Frog ships its own typefaces, so text looks the same on every device.
Every icon comes from one set, drawn at the same weight throughout.
Dropdown menus match the rest of the app on every platform.
Removing a title or unticking an episode offers an Undo.
The command palette searches your library first, then pages, then actions such as Import and Export, and only then the wider TMDB catalogue. Results are grouped under headings.
Home no longer repeats the same show in the hero and the row beneath it.
A show whose next episode has not aired reads as Caught up, with the date the next one arrives.
Several episodes of one show in the same week appear as a single entry.
Pages show a skeleton while they load.
Empty states say what to do next.
Trailer artwork is drawn locally; nothing is requested from YouTube until you press play.
Search ranks popular titles above obscure ones and labels each result Film or Show.
The episode grid shows TMDB scores underneath your own ratings.
The mobile tab bar includes Stats.

groups.title: Fixes
items: Offline mode reports why it is unavailable rather than failing quietly. It needs a secure connection, which Tailscale Serve provides.
Content no longer blanks out while scrolling. Background blur is off by default and adjustable in Settings.
A row holding a single title keeps the normal card size.
Release notes show complete entries, including keyboard shortcuts.
The command palette input sits on one line.
Counts read correctly in the singular.

intro: A face, a home screen and a great deal to adjust.

groups.title: Highlights
items: **Frog has a mascot.** A round green face with big eyes and pink cheeks, readable down to 16 pixels, used as the app icon and the favicon. Four variants to choose from: Classic, Sleepy, Popcorn and 3D glasses.
**The Pond theme**, built from the mascot's colours, alongside Pond Light, Dark and AMOLED.
**A home screen** separate from the library, opening on whatever you are in the middle of, with what to continue, what airs this week and what you added recently.
**A command palette** on <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>K</kbd>.
**A theme editor** with live preview, and themes you can save, duplicate, export and import.

groups.title: Improvements
items: Continue watching uses wide artwork with the show logo, the next episode and a progress bar.
Settings are stored on the server, so a phone and a laptop agree.

Font, text size, corner radius, animation level, card style, poster size, grid spacing, card details, hero style, home row order, landing page, default status, half stars, date format and custom CSS are all adjustable.
Spoiler protection blurs stills for episodes you have not watched.
Search engines are asked not to index the instance.
Remember this device on the sign-in screen, and sign-in is rate limited.
A release notes page, with a marker in the navigation after an update.

groups.title: Fixes
items: The stats page loads.
Internal faults show a readable message and keep the detail in the log.
Libraries containing a title you had never watched load correctly.
Each page sets its own browser tab title.
Episodes without artwork keep the row layout intact.
Episodes that have not aired cannot be ticked or rated, and marking a season watched skips them.

groups.title: Highlights
items: **Track films and shows** from TMDB, with five statuses, ratings, favourites and notes.
**Episode tracking**, one at a time or a season at once, with per-episode ratings and notes.
**Title pages** coloured from their own artwork, with cast, crew, seasons, trailers, franchise order and where to stream.
**Install it on a phone** and keep what you have opened available offline.

groups.title: Improvements
items: Five rating formats, from 100 points to three smileys.
A library wall with filters, sorting and search.
Person pages that highlight what you have already seen.
Runs as a single container, or directly with one script.
